gen-gf-gabarito-gf-exo: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its open terminals letting the shapes spill outward. Exo is a plain sans with wide gaps, and over a long page it stays crisp and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-exo-2: Gabarito has a constant-width pen line and open terminals, and it makes its entrance loudly. Exo 2 follows in sans-serif form, with curves holding plenty of daylight inside, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-faculty-glyphic: Pen-drawn and a bit showy, Gabarito has a w with no thick or thin strokes at all. And Faculty Glyphic, a plain sans with clear openings in its rounded letters, reads steadily and modern across a long stretch.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-fahkwang: Every Gabarito stroke is cut to one width, with open terminals. Fahkwang is a sans with a faint nib pressure in its curves, which gives a longer passage a gentle, approachable pulse.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-finlandica: Gabarito's nib-drawn letters have terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Finlandica is a plain sans with open-mouthed e crossbars and a constant-width outline, so the heading gets to be showy while the text stays clean and followable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-fustat: Gabarito's terminals are cut open, as if one nib drew everything in a single pass. And Fustat, a sans whose lines look like bent rope with a wide gap where the c ends, takes over the text with a modern, relaxed feel.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gantari: Gantari looks wire-bent across whole words, with wide c apertures. Gabarito is the expressive one, with open terminals and a one-nib look, while the plain sans body simply keeps the text approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gayathri: Mild thick-thin variation, like a letterpress slug, gives Gayathri a gentle, approachable sound. Gayathri keeps a long passage moving with open-ended curves, while Gabarito above it holds a steady, pressure-free line.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-google-sans: Gabarito looks drawn by one nib, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Google Sans, a plain sans, pulls its terminals well back.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-google-sans-flex: Google Sans Flex ends its strokes as if cut from one ribbon, each curve finishing in a clean, open gap. And Gabarito, with its one-nib look and outward-flowing counters, makes a long passage feel modern without leaving the text behind.
